name: copy-fn-signatures
description: Right-click any source file → copy all function signatures to clipboard

scripts.sync-version: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const v=process.env.npm_package_version;const tag=process.env.GITHUB_REF_NAME||'';const m=tag.match(/^v?(.+)$/);const ver=m&&m[1]||v;const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));if(p.version!==ver){p.version=ver;fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+'\n');console.log('version -> '+ver);}"
